properties.name: Min Diameter
properties.description: NOT USED BY THIS OPERATOR. Minimum spot diameter, applied when the gridding operator segments spots. The checker only displays the diameter gridding already measured, so changing this here has no effect. Kept so the setting is preserved through the workflow.

properties.name: Max Diameter
properties.description: NOT USED BY THIS OPERATOR. Maximum spot diameter, applied when the gridding operator segments spots. Changing this here has no effect. Kept so the setting is preserved through the workflow.

properties.name: Saturation Limit
properties.description: NOT USED BY THIS OPERATOR. Intensity above which a pixel counts as saturated, applied by the gridding and quantification steps. Changing this here has no effect. Kept so the setting is preserved through the workflow.

properties.name: Spot Pitch
properties.description: Distance between spot centres in pixels. 0 auto-detects from the image dimensions (Evolve3 552x413 uses 17.0, Evolve2 697x520 uses 21.5).

properties.name: EdgeSensitivityLow
properties.description: NOT USED BY THIS OPERATOR. Lower bound of the edge sensitivity range, used by the gridding operator's segmentation. Changing this here has no effect. Kept so the setting is preserved through the workflow.

properties.name: Edge Sensitivity
properties.description: NOT USED BY THIS OPERATOR. Upper bound of the edge sensitivity range, used by the gridding operator's segmentation. Changing this here has no effect. Kept so the setting is preserved through the workflow.

properties.name: Spot Size
properties.description: Fraction of the spot pitch a spot occupies. Drawn spot diameter is Spot Pitch multiplied by Spot Size.

properties.name: Segmentation Method
properties.description: NOT USED BY THIS OPERATOR. Spot segmentation algorithm used by the gridding operator. Changing this here has no effect. Kept so the setting is preserved through the workflow.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: NOT USED BY THIS OPERATOR. Template rotation range for the gridding operator, in the format min:step:max (eg. -2:0.25:2), or 0 to perform intensity based registration. Changing this here has no effect. Kept so the setting is preserved through the workflow.

properties.name: Default Cycle
properties.description: Which image to select when a grid is opened: 'highest' for the highest-numbered cycle, 'grid' for the grid image itself, or an explicit cycle number such as 94.
